serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Landlord: {{punch}}Let’s go maggots! You have some work to do!
You: Huh?!
Why is he here of all people?!
He’s coming my way now…
He probably heard my cry of surprise…
Landlord: Oh, it’s you! The annoying guy that rents a flat from me!
Landlord: I see, that’s the kind of job you do, huh? A real bottom feeder!   
You: Uh, I don’t think I want to work today after all, so I’m going home-
Landlord: {{punch}}Nonsense!
Landlord: Are you really that kind of person that would skip work over any inconvenience?! No wonder you need to go to the labour office to get a job!
You: …
Landlord: Come on! There’s not a lot of people here and I need a big workforce to clean up the mess that these riots did to my many buildings. Thank God our local government is partially funding repairs for people affected by this violence! Especially the big investors hehe~ 
Landlord: Mayor is really kind! How could people rebel like that? It’s pathetic!
You: But our neighbourhood was somehow almost completely intact. Why you, of all people, should get help from the state? 
{{punch}}Ugh! 
Landlord grabbed me by the collar and started whispering…
Landlord: Shut it! One more word and you are evicted!
Landlord: See what you did? One of the clerks is looking at us now! 
Landlord: If someone finds out that I a little~ overestimated damages in the report, I will fucking ruin you!
Landlord: Anyway! Everyone! Let’s go! My poor tenants can’t live in these conditions any longer! I care for them so much…
Some female clerk: Oh my~ He looks a little intimidating, but Mr. Landlord has a heart of gold~
Landlord: Haha! That’s just how I am, sweetcheeks!
You: …
Landlord: Let’s go! I will start the clock when we arrive at the place. We wouldn’t want to waste these precious tax dollars, right? Hehe~
